raw_response: {"diagnosis":"The legacy collector's txn_ts values look shifted +6h. Legacy rows start at about 06:00 each day and run to about 04:41 the next day. Subtracting 6h from legacy rows realigns each batch to a single business day, so silver_transactions is rebuilt that way and the gold tables follow.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.7,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'legacy' THEN txn_ts - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE txn_ts END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'legacy' THEN txn_ts - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE txn_ts END AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
